sections.Profile:
The "Street Fighter II" pinball machine, produced by Gottlieb in March 1993, integrates the popular video game franchise into a pinball format. Designed by Bill Parker, Jon Norris, Mike Vettros, and Ray Tanzer, the game features artwork by Constantino Mitchell, Jeanine Mitchell, and David Moore. Its sound and music were created by Craig Beierwaltes and Dave Zabriskie, respectively.
